title: Issue #2: a silent curated-deps failure ships a broken engine, and the log can never reach us
description: UMBRELLA created 2026-09-01 from GitHub issue #2 (Krea2 gen dies with "Node 'ClownsharKSampler' not found" on a clean 1.4.2 install). Root cause reproduced locally: when ensureCuratedPythonDeps() fails the engine starts anyway, 5 node packs fail to import, and nothing detects or reports it. Members: MPI-673 (surface the failure), MPI-674 (detect it), MPI-675 (make the log reachable). Ships as 1.4.3 off branch 1.4.2 AND lands on master. Members and phase order: tasks/MPI-672/plan.md.
activeSessionTitle: MPI-672 phase 3: cut the 1.4.3 release off branch 1.4.2
